subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Legandry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Legandry"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "Legendary".**
 
• **"Legendary" **means very famous and admired or spoken about a lot. (महान)
 
 
• **Example: **The legendary musician performed his final concert last night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Legandry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wholeness **(पूर्णता): The state of forming a complete and harmonious whole; unity.

 
 
• **Example:** The wholeness of the ecosystem is vital for its health.
 
 
 
• **Overwhelming **(अत्यधिक): Very great in amount; very strong.
 
 
• **Example: **The overwhelming support from the community was heartwarming.
 
 
 
• **Inclusive** (समावेशी): Including all the services or items normally expected or required.
 
 
• **Example:** The conference was very inclusive, welcoming participants from all backgrounds.
